title: Sharks Have A Supernatural 6th Sense 🦈 #shorts #ocean #animals
description: Sharks do not hunt using eyes or smell. They detect the heartbeat of prey using electrical pores. #shorts #shark #nature #sealife
text: Great white sharks do not hunt using their eyesight or sense of smell. They hunt using a supernatural sixth sense. Scattered across a shark's snout are hundreds of tiny jelly-filled pores called the Ampullae of Lorenzini. These microscopic electroreceptors can detect the faint electrical impulse of a prey's beating heart from miles away, locating fish buried under ocean sand in total darkness. text: Deep inside an erupting volcano, molten lava flows at over two thousand degrees Fahrenheit, hot enough to melt solid granite into liquid. title: What Happens If You Fall Into A Black Hole? 🕳️ #shorts #space #physics
description: Crossing the event horizon of a black hole stretches matter into a stream of atoms. #shorts #blackhole #astronomy #universe
text: If you crossed the event horizon of a supermassive black hole, you would be stretched into a single stream of atoms in a process called spaghettification. A black hole's gravitational pull is so unfathomably intense that not even light can escape its grasp. At the center lies a gravitational singularity, a point where infinite density crushes all known laws of physics out of existence. title: A Lion's Roar Shakes Your Entire Body 🦁 #shorts #wildlife #safari
description: A lion's roar reaches 114 decibels and can be heard over 5 miles across the savanna. #shorts #lion #animals #predator
text: A lion's roar is so physically powerful that you can feel the vibrations in your chest from five miles away. Lions have specialized square-shaped vocal cords and a cartilage-reinforced larynx that allows them to roar at one hundred and fourteen decibels without damaging their lungs. Male lions use this acoustic shockwave across the savanna to mark territory and coordinate pride hunting strategies in total darkness. description: An EF5 tornado produces rotational wind speeds exceeding 300 mph, ripping asphalt from roads. #shorts #tornado #severeweather #nature
text: An EF5 tornado produces the fastest wind speeds ever recorded on the surface of the Earth. title: 90% Of An Iceberg Is Invisible Underwater 🧊 #shorts #ocean #earth
description: Why giant icebergs conceal mountain-sized masses of ice beneath the ocean surface. #shorts #iceberg #antarctica #naturefacts
text: Ninety percent of every giant iceberg floating in the ocean is completely invisible beneath the waves. Because pure ice is only about nine percent less dense than saltwater, an iceberg floating in polar seas conceals colossal mountain-sized masses of ice underwater. When massive tabular icebergs calve from Antarctic ice shelves, they can weigh hundreds of billions of tons and drift across oceans for decades before melting.
